bounds.family: ciphertext and plaintext autokey at lags 1-96, one alphabet (std or KRYPTOS), 3 rules, after or before 0084's width-7 double columnar routes
bounds.exhaustive: exact for every second stage done

notes: A ciphertext autokey: >=5 checks K4 0 (coppers 0-8); A plaintext autokey: >=5 checks K4 9 (coppers 5-21); B ciphertext autokey: >=5 checks K4 1 (coppers 0-1); B plaintext autokey: >=5 checks K4 0 (coppers 0-480)
